completion_rule: A consequential capability is not parity-complete until human, accessible-human, automation, agent, platform, and human-authorization states are explicit.

features.human_boundary: Interactive OAuth/OIDC authorization and plan-scope consent stay in the system browser.
features.notes: Automation/agents reuse protected local grants and receive typed AUTH_REQUIRED / PLAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED states.

features.human_boundary: Normal ChatGPT product sign-in/session semantics remain first-party.
features.notes: Embedded product WebView is human-facing; Open in browser is the accessibility fallback. Machines use supported SIWC/Codex surfaces instead of scraping the product UI.

features.human_boundary: Requires an authorized ChatGPT-plan grant.
features.notes: Runtime-discovered model catalog.

features.human_boundary: Requires authorized plan usage.
features.notes: Typed streamed Responses path.

features.human_boundary: Local file access is explicit; inference requires authorized plan usage.
features.notes: GUI picker and machine local-file paths share MIME and size semantics.

features.human_boundary: Subject to model/account/workspace policy.
features.notes: Explicit opt-in on typed path; raw path remains available.

features.human_boundary: Requires authorized plan usage.
features.notes: Preserves arbitrary request fields while enforcing current plan-sharing transport invariants.

features.human_boundary: Requires authorized plan usage.
features.notes: GUI console plus sessionful JSON-RPC machine surface.

features.human_boundary: Privileged/destructive server requests remain explicit approvals.
features.notes: Bundled pinned Codex runtime, typed interview and generic RPC/event surfaces.

features.human_boundary: None for local catalog reads.
features.notes: GUI explorer and machine-readable packaged Codex/SIWC catalogs.

features.human_boundary: Reading the voice catalog does not activate microphone capture or start a realtime session.
features.notes: Named GUI/CLI/JSON-RPC probes map to bundled Codex thread/realtime/listVoices.

features.human_boundary: Status reads never enable remote control, start pairing, or revoke clients.
features.notes: Named GUI/CLI/JSON-RPC probes map to bundled Codex remoteControl/status/read.

features.human_boundary: Catalog reads never install, uninstall, reconcile, or enable plugins.
features.notes: Named GUI/CLI/JSON-RPC probes map to bundled Codex plugin/list.

features.human_boundary: Reading permission profiles requires the existing authorized local runtime but does not change permission policy.
features.notes: GUI, CLI permission-profiles, and JSON-RPC permissions/profiles map to read-only Codex permissionProfile/list.

features.human_boundary: Catalog reads never install, authorize, enable, or mutate apps/connectors.
features.notes: GUI, CLI apps, and JSON-RPC apps/list map to read-only Codex app/list with default parameters.

features.human_boundary: Readiness reads do not start sandbox setup or change the selected sandbox implementation.
features.notes: GUI, CLI sandbox-readiness, and JSON-RPC sandbox/readiness map to Codex windowsSandbox/readiness.

features.human_boundary: None.
features.notes: Keyboard, semantic automation metadata, live status, high-contrast/theme following, DPI scaling, browser fallback, CLI and JSON-RPC contract.

features.human_boundary: None.
features.notes: Persisted 80-200% native-interface scale and reduced-motion preference are shared by GUI, CLI and JSON-RPC.

features.human_boundary: OS install permissions remain platform-defined.
features.notes: Per-user install/uninstall plus GUI/CLI/agent entry points.

features.human_boundary: Opening local files is explicit user/machine input.
features.notes: suprachat:// and platform file/open integration feed the same core.

features.human_boundary: None.
features.notes: Alt+Space is additive; ordinary keyboard/application launch paths remain available.

features.human_boundary: OS notification permissions/preferences apply.
features.notes: Windows uses the native notification-area adapter, macOS uses the system notification service, and Linux uses the freedesktop notification path when notify-send/a notification daemon is available. Notifications are never the only way state is conveyed.

features.human_boundary: Capture is explicit only. OS desktop/session/screen-recording/compositor permissions remain authoritative; no automatic/background screenshot is taken.
features.notes: One shared Core sensor backs GUI Capture screen & attach, CLI screen-status/screen-capture, and JSON-RPC screen/status/screen/capture. Headless or permission-denied hosts return typed unavailability/failure.

features.human_boundary: Microphone/camera permissions must remain human-controlled.
features.notes: First-party product and Codex realtime evidence exist; native cross-audience adapters remain incomplete. Completion requires text transcript/equivalent state for spoken output, structured permission state, and keyboard/machine-reachable stop/cancel.

features.human_boundary: Navigation is an explicit caller action. The clean-room browser is isolated from the first-party ChatGPT WebView/session and does not inherit browser cookies or credentials.
features.notes: Pinned Playwright/Chromium substrate. GUI uses a visible isolated session with explicit Stop; CLI/JSON-RPC expose ephemeral semantic snapshots. Automation supports one-shot role/name click and label-based fill; agent JSON-RPC additionally exposes sessionful start/navigate/read/click/fill/stop. Every action returns an AI-optimized ARIA snapshot.

features.human_boundary: Computer/browser control requires explicit authority, permissions and approvals.
features.notes: Clean-room browser substrate now implements semantic observation plus role/name click and labeled-input fill across human/automation/agent paths. Remaining qualification frontier: packaged Chromium, screenshots/visual fallback, general pointer/keyboard primitives, downloads/uploads, multi-tab/context lifecycle, permission capture and explicit higher-risk approval policy.

features.human_boundary: Status/pairing-status/client-list are read-only. Enable/disable/pairing-start/client-revoke require an explicit one-shot human confirmation or machine confirm=true/--confirm; no operation auto-approves Codex server requests.
features.notes: Complete semantic lifecycle is implemented across GUI, CLI and JSON-RPC. Pairing/environment/client IDs are text-accessible; live authorized qualification on each OS remains pending.

features.human_boundary: Projection reads are derived and non-authoritative. Consequential work remains gated by the owning workstream/controller authority; capture does not imply commitment.
features.notes: One shared WorkProjectionEngine feeds the native accessible renderer, CLI work-projection command, and work/projection/read JSON-RPC method. Rich/compact/restricted are projection contexts over the same workstream, not separate authorities.
